title: Best Phone Gimbal (2026)
summary: The top phone gimbals for 2026 are the Hohem iSteady M7, Joby Smart Stabilizer, DJI Osmo Mobile 8P, Insta360 Flow 2 Pro, and Hohem iSteady Mobile+.
method: Picks were made by reviewing the product recommendations in TechRadar (source 1) and PCMag (source 3); products were chosen for overall performance, unique features, and value, with preference for those appearing in multiple lists where possible.
assumptions: Prices are shown only when explicitly stated in a source; otherwise price is null. No external data was used.

products.name: DJI Osmo Mobile 8P
why: TechRadar recommends the DJI Osmo Mobile 8P for users who want a compact premium gimbal with a dedicated remote control, improving on the previous model’s lack of a remote.
It folds for easy storage and offers subject tracking, making it a well‑rounded choice for most smartphones.
cons: Touchscreen controls can feel less responsive
May struggle with very heavy phones
products.best_for: Creators who value a built‑in remote and portability
products.skip_if: You need the fastest on‑the‑fly control response
products.amazon_listing: Phone Gimbal Stabilizer for DJI Osmo Mobile 8P Creator Vlog Combo | Smartphone Stabilizer

products.name: Insta360 Flow 2 Pro
why: PCMag highlights the Insta360 Flow 2 Pro for its effective stabilization, up to 10 hours of battery life, and ultra‑compact folding design, making it ideal for on‑the‑go creators.
An integrated extension rod also helps capture high‑angle shots, adding versatility beyond its small footprint.
cons: May lack some advanced tracking features of higher‑end models
products.best_for: Travel vloggers needing long runtime in a tiny package
products.skip_if: You require advanced AI tracking or built‑in lighting
products.amazon_listing: Insta360 Flow 2 Pro Phone Gimbal Stabilizer for iPhone & Android, AI Phone Gimbal, Phone S

products.name: Hohem iSteady Mobile+
why: PCMag lists the Hohem iSteady Mobile+ as a strong value pick, offering effective stabilization and subject tracking for all smartphone sizes, including large flagship models, at an attractive $99 price.
Its performance is comparable to larger gimbals while remaining relatively compact and budget‑friendly.
specs: Supports all smartphone sizes, including large flagships
cons: Slightly larger than some ultra‑compact rivals
Limited advanced features compared to premium models
products.best_for: Users who want solid performance without breaking the bank
products.skip_if: You need premium features like a detachable remote or LED light
